title: Ride Smoothness and Comfort
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on the G60’s smooth, comfortable ride, but many fragments are too brief or isolated to determine clear overall sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle for riding smoothly, feeling comfortable, and delivering a pleasing daily driving experience.

negative.summary: The only negative-assigned example still describes an exceptionally smooth ride, so the reason for the negative assignment is not clear from the fragment alone.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention smoothness or favorable ride comparisons, but they are too short or lack enough context to confirm the speaker’s overall sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short ride-quality remarks, which limits confidence in interpreting full review sentiment.
One negative-assigned fragment contains strongly positive wording, so the underlying reason for that label cannot be resolved from the provided text alone.
Samples are stratified and not representative estimates of overall customer experience.
